messages:
samir_sales: Quick ask 
Customer: Meridian Health Network. Requesting one-time exception: 30% off Dedicated list for 12mo + waive onboarding SOW. Also asking Net60 due to fiscal cycle. Need finance + deal desk OK by Fri.

claire_dealdesk: What's TCV and strategic rationale? Any precedent for this stack?

samir_sales: Proposed TCV = $420k (list $600k). Theyre potential multi-region ref and plan to pilot integrations across 4 hospitals in Y2 (~$1.1M). Procurement insists on Net60, no upfront.

jordan_finance: Numbers check:
List $600k, Proposed $420k (30% off). Margin at proposed ~20% after infra.
Finance can provisionally accept 30% + waived SOW only if: (1) signed PO before provisioning, (2) 10% non-refundable initial invoice or proof of budget award, (3) convert SOW fee to time-limited credits if customer refuses cash, and (4) include 12mo expansion clawback. Also no stacking with promos.

eva_revops: Need operational controls: metering alerts, onboarding owner, and credit application schedule. Billing team must confirm SKU mapping.

rachel_legal: Ill draft amendment with clawback math, payment milestone, and confidentiality/reference language. Send SOW lines.

billing-bot: Invoice template stub created: /invoices/templates/meridian_specialpricing_v1.docx

samir_sales: I'll push for PO and send SOW to @rachel_legal. Will update once PO lands. Thanks. :pray:
